options.name: enabled
options.description: If set to True, the Alias will be enabled If set to False, the Alias will not be enabled

options.name: interface
options.description: Select the interface for the V6 dynamic IP

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the alias may only consist of the characters "a-z, A-Z, 0-9 and _"

options.name: refreshfrequency
options.description: The frequency that the list will be refreshed, in days + hours, so 1 day and 8 hours means the alias will be refreshed after 32 hours.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether alias should be added or removed.

options.name: statistics
options.description: Maintain a set of counters for each table entry

options.name: type
options.description: The type used for the Alias hosts (Single hosts by IP or Fully Qualified Domain Name or host exclusions (starts with '!' sign)) networks (Entire network p.e. 192.168.1.1/24 or network exclusion eg !192.168.1.0/24) ports (Port numbers or a port range like 20:30) urls (A table of IP addresses that are fetched once) urltable (A table of IP addresses that are fetched on regular intervals.) geoip (Select countries or whole regions) disclaimer -> validation is not supported at this point networkgroup
